subject: per-phy-u-fund
title: PER.PHY.U.FUND.------SPT.DYM.
description: Diagram closing MP(II)-5, within Level Two of Music and Politics. The prose immediately above names the structural ground: 'the use of transfer cycles would play a great role in helping to establish creativity as a political tool, and the particulars of this phenomenon are directly related to what cycle we choose to focus on... the creativity of any region is related to the composite reality of that region (including its physical universe particulars).' The crossing diagrams what 'physical universe fundamental' produces when crossed with the transfer-cycle's working dynamism: (C)PER-PHY-U-FUND (the concept of perceived physical universe fundamental) is crossed with SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics). PER-PHY-U-FUND sits at the lower-left as subject, and the main line runs from it to SPT-DYM at upper-right; RIT-DY (ritual dynamics) rises from the main line at top-center, AFTD (affinity tendencies) branches from the RIT-DY line at the upper-left, and POST (postulation) branches from the AFTD line. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) drops from the main line to the bottom; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) branches from the PROG-CONT line out to the right margin. From the RT-ALGN line, SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) rises at the right, with LANG-DY (language dynamics) branching from it toward the center, and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) runs down to the lower-right. The State Department, the next page says, has used creative music as a political tool since the middle forties.
